maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The image displays two separate crops of the mystacial pads. In the upper crop (right muzzle), the uppermost row contains 3 distinct clusters: the leftmost is faint, while the two rightmost are high-contrast and situated dorsally to the 3rd and 5th spots of the dense row below. In the lower crop (left muzzle), the uppermost row contains 2 high-contrast clusters situated dorsally to the 2nd and 4th spots of the dense row below.
